LESSON: GUIDED WRITING

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: GERMAN
Strand: Writing
Topic 3.1: Guided Writing

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! This is a study lesson on Guided Writing. Read the explanation, follow every worked example, then do the practice. This is original CBC Learn content written from KICD outcomes — not a copy of a commercial textbook.

Big question: Why is writing important in communication?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify appropriate vocabulary for writing
2. write texts using appropriate register and language structures
3. appreciate the role of writing skills in understanding texts

SECTION 3: STUDY NOTES (READ AND LEARN)

WHAT YOU ARE LEARNING: GUIDED WRITING
This lesson teaches Guided Writing for Grade 9 GERMAN.

STUDY STEPS
1. identify appropriate vocabulary for writing
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
2. write texts using appropriate register and language structures
   Practise this until you can do it without help.
3. appreciate the role of writing skills in understanding texts
   Practise this until you can do it without help.

HOW TO SHOW UNDERSTANDING
Explain the idea in your own words, give one Kenyan example, then complete the practice tasks.

SECTION 4: QUICK EXAMPLES

Example 1: Describe Guided Writing using something at your school.

Example 2: Give a home/community example from your county.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: PRACTICE NOW

1. Underline the key ideas about Guided Writing above.
2. Explain Guided Writing to a parent using one local example.
3. Write or draw three things that prove you understand Guided Writing.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (HOME / REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Guided Writing with school or home examples.
2. Answer: Why is Guided Writing important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Prepare a one-minute oral presentation for a parent or teacher.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. Why is writing important in communication?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify appropriate vocabulary for writing
2. write texts using appropriate register and language structures
3. appreciate the role of writing skills in understanding texts

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original study notes from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
